detailed_description:
The target video is a vertical 9:16 indoor home-advertisement style with warm soft ceiling light, clean beige tones, and a handheld vlog feel, exactly matching the look of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] A vertical medium full shot opens in the beige marble-tiled corridor of <Subject 3>, with white and wood-trimmed doors behind. <Subject 1>, the young woman from ref_images.ref_image_0 with wispy air bangs, long black low twin tails, and a translucent pink sheer chiffon wrap dress over a pink inner set, walks toward the camera carrying the stack of three blue Vinda soft packs from <Subject 2> in both arms, smiling and speaking on-screen as (S1); her spoken Chinese lines follow drive_audio's exact wording, timing, and rhythm with locked lip sync. The handheld camera holds a medium shot and drifts slightly backward as she approaches; the sheer sleeves and dress hem sway softly with her steps, and the warm corridor light falls on her skin and the translucent chiffon.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.750, the shot cuts to a close-up in front of the bathroom mirror of <Subject 3>, where the tiled wall shows the Doraemon suction hook and ring-light reflections. <Subject 1> holds the blue hanging pack of <Subject 2> up at chest height with one hand and points with her other hand at the printed label reading "Vinda 维达", "超韧Plus挂抽", "厚韧如棉 湿水不易破", and "M 280抽", kept in the original Chinese. Her face enters the frame edge in profile at the start, then the pack fills the center as the handheld camera tilts and drifts slowly with her hand; she keeps speaking as (S1) in sync with drive_audio.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.042, the shot cuts to a high-angle close-up over the white ceramic sink and chrome single-lever faucet of <Subject 3>. The hands of <Subject 1> dip a white tissue sheet from <Subject 2> into the clear water in the basin, lift it dripping, and stretch it horizontally between both hands to show its wet strength; water drops fall back into the basin with soft splashes. Around 00:08.000, a rectangular inset graphic of clear blue water with rising bubbles briefly overlays the center of the frame for about one second, aligned to the original rhythm, then disappears. <Subject 1> (S1) continues speaking off-screen, driven by drive_audio, while the wet tissue sags and rebounds with realistic cloth physics.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a selfie-style medium close-up beside the mirror: the hanging pack of <Subject 2> now hangs from the Doraemon hook on the tiled wall of <Subject 3>, with a tissue sheet trailing from its bottom opening. <Subject 1> leans into the left of frame, smiling and speaking to camera as (S1) in sync with drive_audio, reaches across, and pulls one tissue from the bottom of the pack; the pack swings gently on the hook and the remaining sheet sways before settling. The handheld camera stays at her eye level with a slight drift, ending on her bright smile toward the lens.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet warm indoor room tone continues throughout the video. The copied vocal layer from drive_audio serves as the continuous Chinese speech of <Subject 1> in all four shots, accompanied by soft fabric rustle of the sheer dress and tissue sheets, light plastic-pack crinkle when the packs are handled, and water splashes and drips in the sink during [Shot 3].
